channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Israel bombs Lebanon’s capital
item.description: Israel has bombed areas in southern Beirut, as well as conducting a special operation in the Bekaa Valley.

item.title: The conflict is spreading ‘quickly and dangerously’ – Middle East security expert
item.description: We spoke to Emile Hokayem, the Director of Regional Security at the International Institute for Strategic Studies.

item.title: Do Brits fear being dragged into an illegal war?
item.description: The extent of the UK's involvement in this war has significantly changed in the week since Israel and the US first began to strike Iran. What do people think?

item.title: Iranians in London react to Supreme Leader’s death
item.description: For many in the Iranian diaspora, Ayatollah Khamenei's death is a moment of hope; a chance to turn the page on decades of oppression.

item.title: Israel launches new ‘wide-scale strikes’ on Iran
item.description: In the last hour - Israel says it has launched a new wave of strikes on Iran and promised to kill whoever has been chosen as the new Supreme Leader.

item.title: War in Iran has ‘terrible parallels with Gaza’ – director of international crisis group
item.description: We spoke to the director of Crisis Group's Iran Project - Ali Vaez - in Geneva.

item.title: Trump U-Turns on Kurds joining the war
item.description: In another change of heart - President Trump has now insisted he doesn't want Kurdish fighters in Iraq to cross into Iran.

item.title: Israelis strike central Beirut
item.description: There has been more fighting in southern Lebanon - our international editor Lindsey Hilsum is in Beirut.

item.title: Trump and Starmer speak after the US President’s mocking criticism
item.description: Sir Keir Starmer spoke to President Trump this afternoon.

item.title: Blair’s legacy in Iraq means we need to ‘stop and think’ – former ambassador, Lord Ricketts
item.description: Earlier we spoke to the UK's former national security adviser Lord Peter Ricketts.
